{{Quote|Recall the Sun Guard. When they're done here&ndash;''"<br />"''No. I know where the Gran are. It won't be business as usual this time, Master.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
The '''massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy''' took place in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]] of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] in the [[Gran Protectorate Embassy|embassy]] by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis']] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], thus removing an opponent to the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Lords]].

==Prelude==
Senator Pax Teem decided to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] Senator Palpatine of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and his ally [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] due to Naboo's position at a recent vote in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and the conspiracies the two engaged in. To that end, Teem hired [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to kidnap and kill Palpatine while others would attack Hego Damask at the initiation of [[Larsh Hill]] into the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] at their lodge in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]]. He was unaware that Palpatine and Damask were secretly [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Palpatine had then been kidnapped and conversed briefly with Teem before [[Sun Guard]]s rescued him. He conversed with Damask who told him to go about his usual business, and so he headed for his residence. When [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] arrived, Palpatine suddenly realized that Teem had also targeted Damask and the two rushed to the lodge. The Maladian assassins infiltrated the [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|lodge]] and killed Larsh Hill along with several others, and gravely wounding Damask. However, Sate Pestage and Palpatine arrived at the scene and eliminated the assassins but Damask was forced to wear a [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]] as a result of his sustained wounds.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==The massacre==
After the assassination attempt on Damask failed and the Sun Guard discovered that Teem was hosting a party in the Gran Protectorate Embassy to celebrate his presumed victory over the Muun, Darth Sidious went there to kill Teem personally, with [[Darth Plagueis's lightsaber|his master's lightsaber]]. Purposely leaving Teem for last, Sidious slaughtered everyone else who was present, including the guests that Teem had invited to a feast. After butchering Teem's family, friends and guests right before his horrified eyes, Sidious used the Force to [[Pyrokinesis|set fire]] to a floor-to-ceiling curtain that fell atop the Gran, enveloping him and roasting him alive.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Aftermath==
After surviving the attempt on his life and deciding that Damask Holdings would not be reformed, Hego Damask retreated from the affairs of the Galaxy, with some presuming him dead. By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Pax Teem had been succeeded by his aide, [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] and [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
